title: Baghdad Phantom mission report released early (was due for declassification in 2047)

tellings.quote: mission report from the Baghdad Phantom. That was supposed to be declassified in 2047.

plain: A military mission report about the "Baghdad Phantom," an unexplained object linked to Baghdad, Iraq, is said to have been released years early, when it was meant to stay secret until 2047. The journalist Jeremy Corbell says so, citing named sources. In his words, it was the "mission report from the Baghdad Phantom. That was supposed to be declassified in 2047."
